title: Senior Cloud Architect
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Business Area IT

We design and build the digital backbone that moves Vattenfall forward — from modern infrastructure to large-scale digital transformation initiatives. We connect people, processes and technology while enabling automation, innovation and an intuitive user experience. By doing so, we create a smart and connected organisation that is ready for tomorrow's energy transition.

Job Description

Is there a way to shape the future of cloud technology while accelerating the energy transition?

As a Cloud Architect, you will play a key role in designing the digital foundations that help power a more sustainable energy system. At Vattenfall, we believe there is a way to create a future where technology, innovation and sustainability go hand in hand. By driving cloud transformation across our international business, you will help enable scalable, secure and future-ready solutions that support our long-term ambition of building a cleaner energy future.

Your role

As Cloud Architect at Vattenfall, you will guide the design and evolution of cloud and infrastructure solutions, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure. You will help shape enterprise-wide cloud standards, governance frameworks and architecture principles while supporting both cloud-native development and the migration of existing applications.

This is an opportunity to influence cloud adoption at scale, work with modern enterprise technologies and contribute directly to Vattenfall's digital transformation journey.

Key responsibilities:

    Designing, developing and governing enterprise-grade cloud platforms and infrastructure solutions in Microsoft Azure
    Defining architecture standards, reference architectures and best practices for cloud adoption
    Supporting the migration of business-critical applications to Azure using modern architectural principles
    Designing and implementing Azure Landing Zones, management group structures and policy-based governance
    Collaborating with application teams, security specialists and external partners to ensure scalable and secure solutions
    Driving cloud security initiatives based on Zero Trust principles and Microsoft security frameworks
    Contributing to hybrid platform architectures integrating Azure, SAP ERP, Kafka and other business-critical technologies
    Advising stakeholders on cloud strategy, technology choices and long-term architectural roadmaps
    Promoting operational excellence, automation and continuous improvement across the cloud landscape

Location

Stockholm, Amsterdam, Berlin and Katowice

Qualifications

Who are you?

You are an experienced cloud professional who enjoys collaborating across teams and transforming complex technical challenges into practical and sustainable solutions. You combine deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and can explain cloud concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Next to this we believe you bring:

    At least 7 years of experience designing and implementing cloud infrastructure solutions
    Extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure
    A curious mindset and enthusiasm for exploring new technologies and innovative solutions
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups

Cloud Security Expertise

    Strong understanding of Azure networking, identity management and cloud security
    Experience guiding enterprise-scale application migrations to Azure
    Experience implementing Azure Security Baselines and secure-by-design architectures
    Experience applying Zero Trust Architecture principles
    Practical knowledge of Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and Conditional Access
    Understanding of cloud compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001/27002, GDPR and the EU AI Act

Frameworks & Standards

    Experience working with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
    Solid knowledge of Azure governance, management groups, policies and landing zones
    Knowledge of Azure Well-Architected Framework (WAF), especially Security and Operational Excellence
    Strong understanding of Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark (MCSB) and Microsoft Defender for Cloud

Additional Information

Our offer

A challenging and independent job in an informal, dynamic working environment. You can play a part in shaping the future of a company where the only constant is change. Besides being a challenging and inspiring place to work, we value a great work atmosphere!

At Vattenfall, we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of gender, age, and ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We believe in work life balance and the flexibility to work from home.

More Information

This position is primarily intended for internal candidates within Vattenfall. In case of equal qualifications, preference will be given to colleagues from Business Unit IT (YI). We value internal growth and encourage you to apply.”

We welcome your application in English, no later than, 15th of September 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the role, please contact the Hiring Manager Emile Das: emile.das@vattenfall.com for more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our Recruiter Marius Gläßge (marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de).

Trade union representatives in Sweden (IT) are Sofi Wadström (Akademikerna), Patricia Ek (Unionen), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna), Juha Siipilehto (SEKO). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity.

title: Product Owner - Hybrid Cloud
description:
Are you ready to take ownership of a strategic hybrid cloud portfolio and help create simpler, smarter, and more automated infrastructure services? Then this could be your next step!

Why Sandvik?

Joining us, you own a strategic service area connecting cloud and on-premises infrastructure in a global IT environment, helping shape the future of hybrid cloud services.

    Shape services across Microsoft Azure, Enterprise Private Cloud, and on-premises infrastructure.
    Drive AI, automation, simplification, and operational excellence in hybrid cloud.
    Collaborate with architects, operations teams, partners, and stakeholders.
    Join the Core IT Services leadership team and contribute to broader strategic decisions.

About your job

As Product Owner for Hybrid Cloud, you own the service direction, roadmap, backlog, and governance for Sandvik’s hybrid infrastructure services. The focus is on making services easy to consume, reducing operational complexity, and increasing automation while ensuring high-quality service delivery through strategic partner governance. You also act as Service Owner, ensuring services continuously evolve in line with business and stakeholder needs.

Job responsibilities

    Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for hybrid cloud services.
    Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business needs, value, and strategic direction.
    Govern service delivery partners, ensuring quality, scope, service levels, and lifecycle commitments are met.
    Lead AI and automation initiatives across core operational processes, including provisioning, patching, backup, and billing.
    Drive service governance, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and continuous improvement activities.
    Support the evolution of unified infrastructure management across cloud and on-premises environments.
    Own the budget for the hybrid cloud service area, including forecasting, cost control, and financial accountability for partner spend.

Location

This position is based in Sandviken or Stockholm.

Your profile

You bring experience from product ownership, product management, or a similar role within IT service delivery. Comfortable navigating between strategic priorities and operational governance, you know how to create clarity, manage stakeholders, and drive value in complex environments. You lead the team delivering the product through influence and clear direction — accountable for outcomes and performance, while formal people management sits with the Competence Manager

Your background includes:

    Experience owning or managing infrastructure, hybrid cloud, or managed services in an enterprise IT environment.
    Experience prioritizing backlogs and governing delivery based on business context and stakeholder needs.
    Strong vendor and partner management skills, including accountability for quality, scope, and delivery outcomes.
    Understanding of service lifecycle management, service catalogues, governance, and financial responsibility.
    A commercial mindset, with the ability to negotiate value, manage costs, and hold partners accountable to commercial outcomes — not just delivery
    Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

We see it as a plus if you have experience with agile product practices, ITIL, Microsoft Azure, Azure Arc, AIOps, or cloud financial governance.

Success in this position comes from combining a structured and accountable approach with strong collaboration and communication skills. You’re comfortable making decisions, managing competing priorities, and building trusted relationships across technical and business communities. A proactive mindset and a passion for automation help you create sustainable improvements and long-term value.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Muna Muse Kurasch, hiring manager, +46 (0)76-276 15 18

We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.

Union contacts – Sweden

    Malena Rackner, Unionen, +46 (0)70 242 33 90
    Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87
    Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70 222 48 55

Recruitment Specialist: Lotta Amnebjer Nordqvist

How to apply

Send your application no later than September 1st, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0094436.

We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.

To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

title: Application/Integration developer
description:
Dellner Couplers is seeking an Application/Integration developer to join our IT team. Dellner Couplers – a Wabtec Company - is a leading international company delivering sustainable, innovative, and high‑quality products and services to train operators and train builders worldwide. Our product portfolio includes couplers, gangways, and crash management systems for the railway industry.

About the Role

This role offers excellent opportunities for professional growth and development. You will play a key role in supporting the IT organization and participate in development initiatives related to integrations mainly with our ERP system Infor M3 and other systems within Dellner.

We develop and maintain integrations and small applications across Dellner system landscape. Integration based on technologies like M3 IEC, Infor ION, Java, XML, XSL, XSD and programming languages C#, Javascript, .Net, .Net Core, ASP .Net Core, azorpages and REST.



Experience with MS SQL, Visual Studio, Azure Devops and GIT is preferred.



The position involves a varied workload, managing both smaller tasks and larger projects in parallel, and close collaboration with colleagues from multiple functions globally.

Key Responsibilities

    Develop and maintain applications and integrations
    Develop and maintain e-Invoicing and payment files
    Participate in IT projects with integration needs

Organization & Location

The role is based at our head office in Vika, Falun and reports to the Global IT-Manger.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone with a relevant university degree in IT, logistics, analytics, or a related field or equivalent professional experience. Experience in programming or scripting, such as SQL, TypeScript, or VBA, is highly valued. Familiarity with ERP systems is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

To succeed in the role, you should have:

    Strong analytical skills combined with a holistic mindset
    Strong in spoken and written English
    A structured and organized way of working
    An open-minded and proactive attitude
    A willingness to learn and support others in the team

Who are we

Dellner Couplers is an industry leader in the design, manufacture and service of Train Connection Systems for train builders and rail operators worldwide.

The path we have chosen is characterized by steady growth in a rapidly evolving technological environment. Every day we strive for excellent, innovative and sustainable solutions for our products and services.

Dellner joined Wabtec Corporation in February 2026. This strategic acquisition strengthens our capabilities, enabling us to deliver broader expertise, enhanced innovation and greater value to our customers worldwide.

Here you have a unique opportunity to:

    Join a global and growing organization within the railway industry
    Work with modern ERP and BI solutions in an international environment
    Contribute to the development of data-driven and efficient business processes
    Collaborate with experienced colleagues across multiple functions and countries
    Develop both your technical and business understanding in a role with broad responsibility
    Be part of a company with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and long-term development

At Dellner Couplers, we value collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We offer a dynamic workplace where your ideas and contributions make a real impact.

How to apply

Ready to make an impact? Submit your application by 9th of September. Applications can be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Questions?

Contact hiring manager: Björn Thune, +46705517720 or bjorn.thune@dellner.com

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
⚡️ What We Do

Swiftly gaining ground as Sweden’s industry leader in battery storage and expanding rapidly in selected European markets, Flower is on a mission to enable the energy system of tomorrow.

With an industry-leading AI-powered platform at its core, our service includes stabilizing the energy system by enhancing predictability and flexibility for both energy producers and consumers. By combining pioneering technology with a portfolio of flexible energy assets, we break new ground towards a fossil-free energy system, allowing clean energy to power society.

🌟Who We Are

Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core.﻿ Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.

At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.

To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Construction Project Manager to join our team.

👩‍💻 About The Role:

As our Construction Project Manager you'll own the construction and execution phase of our battery energy storage system (BESS) projects from breaking ground to commercial operation date (COD). You'll be the main point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, keep project controls and documentation on track, lead delivery and commissioning activities on site, and ultimately hand a fully operational asset over to our Asset Management team or another third party. It's a technical, hands-on role for someone who thrives on turning complex EPC projects into successfully delivered, high-performing assets.

What You'll Do:

    

Oversee day-to-day operations - manage all project and site logistics

    

Maintain project controls - own schedule, budget, and change management throughout the construction and execution phase, lead weekly meetings with contractors, and report KPIs and progress to management

    

Manage contractor relationships - review and evaluate contractor bids and submittals, respond to RFIs, hold contractors accountable to scope and schedule, and resolve on-site issues and disputes as they arise

    

Drive HSE compliance across all contractors on site and ensure construction and installation work meets all quality and safety standards

    

Lead commissioning and handover - coordinate and lead commissioning activities on site, and manage the handover to a fully operational asset, including as-built documentation, O&M manuals, warranties, and punch list closeout

    

Manage project compliance and ensure grid connection works stay on schedule

    

Act as the main point of contact for internal teams and external stakeholders

    

Travel to site as required

Who You Are:

    

A degree in Engineering, Construction Management or equivalent qualifications & experience

    

3+ years of experience in Construction Management, Site Management, Construction Project Engineering, or similar

    

Fluency in English, German is a plus

    

Proven experience working in energy infrastructure construction projects

    

Familiar with European building codes and regulations

    

Proficient with Microsoft Projects, Excel and AutoCAD

    

Problem-solving, decision-making, organisation skills are key to succeed

    

Solid knowledge in BESS systems is a plus

📍 Location

Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.

✉️ Apply

Our corporate language is English, as we have about 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.

Throughout the recruitment process you will meet with the Talent Partner, the Hiring Manager, the Team, and the VP Asset Development.

We look forward to hearing from you!

—-

We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.

title: Labor Demand Expert
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Labour Demand Expert, you own the logic that translates store demand signals into workload and labour hours.

Rather than forecasting sales or managing staffing plans directly, you build and continuously improve the global labour demand model that determines how operational demand is converted into workload requirements across our retail environments.

You ensure labour allocation is data-driven, fair and aligned with both commercial and operational realities across store formats, customer missions and markets.

You will:

    Own and continuously develop the end-to-end labour demand model, translating customer demand, operational activities and workload drivers into labour hours
    Define how demand signals such as customer traffic, transactions, deliveries, omnichannel activity and operational complexity translate into workload requirements
    Ensure the model reflects real store activity patterns and evolves with changes in customer behaviour, omnichannel flows and operating models
    Define, document and maintain assumptions, scaling rules and calculation logic in a clear and structured way
    Build logic for daily, weekly and seasonal variation, including store-type, format and size scaling factors
    Analyse relationships between demand, workload, productivity and labour consumption to improve model accuracy
    Support scenario modelling to assess labour impacts of new store formats, omnichannel initiatives, operational changes and productivity improvements
    Partner closely with Labour Standards and Workforce Management experts to ensure demand logic translates effectively into labour standards, staffing recommendations and workforce planning outputs
    Act as a subject matter expert on labour demand logic, supporting both technical and non-technical stakeholders

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will work closely with Controlling, Operations Development, Labour Standards, Workforce Management, Tech and Product teams, as well as global teams and Sales Markets.

In this role, you act as a key link between customer demand, operational workload and labour planning, ensuring labour demand logic is understood, consistently applied and scalable across markets.

WHO YOU ARE

You are an analytical and structured problem-solver who enjoys understanding how operational demand creates work. You are comfortable building models, analysing complex drivers and translating operational reality into scalable planning logic.

We are looking for people with:

    Experience in labour demand modelling, operational analytics, workforce planning, capacity planning, operational modelling or workload forecasting
    Experience translating demand drivers, customer activity, workload patterns or operational volume into labour requirements
    Strong analytical and modelling skills with the ability to work with large and complex datasets
    Experience building, documenting and maintaining operational models, assumptions and calculation logic
    Understanding of customer-driven operational environments such as retail, logistics, delivery operations, fulfilment, warehousing or similar high-volume operations
    Strong understanding of operational drivers such as customer traffic, transactions, deliveries, workloads, productivity factors and omnichannel flows
    Experience translating complex models and assumptions into practical guidance for business stakeholders
    Strong documentation skills and attention to detail
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken
    

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

An example of our benefits:

    25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
    H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.
    

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Lead Architectural Project Manager - Data Centres
description:
Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At Arkitema, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.



Therefore, we are looking for a Lead Architectural Project Manager to join us. In this role, you will work closely with clients, colleagues, and partners to shape and deliver data centre projects from early concept through to design and implementation. From day one, you will engage directly with clients - leading meetings, guiding decision-making, and driving the delivery of CSA disciplines across projects. You will translate global concepts into locally compliant solutions while structuring teams and workflows to ensure efficient execution.

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.



Lead multidisciplinary design for mission‑critical projects

As Lead Architectural Project Manager you will provide overall design leadership. You will align client requirements, technical disciplines and operational priorities, and help teams navigate complexity without losing sight of what creates value - throughout all project phases from concept to handover.



Your key responsibilities will be to:

    Lead multidisciplinary design delivery for data centre projects.
    Ensure coordinated delivery across a large multidisciplinary project team, including discipline leads and international engineering teams.
    Set clear direction, create clarity, and facilitate effective collaboration.
    Oversee project financials, reporting to steering committees, and proactive risk management.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you -colleagues, partners and customers. You act respectfully, listen actively and follow through on your commitments. And you remain curious about new perspectives and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

    A relevant educational background in project management, architecture, engineering or a related field.
    Experience working with engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
    Experience from data centre projects or other large‑scale, mission‑critical facilities.
    Experience leading large, multidisciplinary project teams.
    Professional proficiency in English – verbal and written.

Work location

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia:

Norway – Oslo, Trondheim or Stavanger.

Sweden – Stockholm or Gothenburg.

Denmark – Copenhagen or Aarhus.



We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.



Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mette Gutte on mtgt@COWI.com



Get to know us even better at our website, www.arkitema.com and www.cowi.com



A place to work and so much more

At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.



Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you are interested in joining Arkitema. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.



Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

title: Personlig assistent sökes till spansktalande kvinna i Hisings Backa
description:
Vi söker en spansktalande kvinnlig personlig assistent till en rullstolsbunden kvinna i Hisings Backa.

Som personlig assistent är du en viktig del av den assistansberättigades vardag. Arbetet innebär att ge stöd och hjälp med de personliga och praktiska behov som uppstår i vardagen, utifrån hennes önskemål och behov.

Vem söker vi?

Det viktigaste är att personkemin stämmer. Du behöver vara lyhörd, respektfull och ha lätt för att samarbeta. Du ska kunna arbeta självständigt, men också fungera bra tillsammans med övriga assistenter.

Eftersom den assistansberättigade är spansktalande är goda kunskaper i spanska ett krav.

För tjänsten söker vi kvinnliga assistenter, eftersom detta är ett önskemål från den assistansberättigade.

    har erfarenhet av palliativ vård
    har erfarenhet av sondmatning

Erfarenhet är meriterande, men personlig lämplighet och att du fungerar bra tillsammans med den assistansberättigade är mycket viktigt.

Arbetstid

Arbetet är schemalagt och omfattar:

    dag- och kvällspass
    helgarbete
    vaken natt

Arbetstiderna varierar enligt schema.

Vi erbjuder

Du blir en del av ett team där ett gott samarbete och en trygg relation med den assistansberättigade är viktigt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att hitta personer som passar in både hos den assistansberättigade och i arbetsgruppen.

Arbetsplats: Hisings Backa, Göteborg

Låter detta som ett arbete för dig? Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan!

title: Android Developer
description:
About Us

Mullvad VPN is a Swedish VPN company dedicated to fighting mass surveillance and censorship. We do this primarily through our VPN service and our privacy-focused web browser. Over the years, we have been pioneers when it comes to VPN technology and we intend to remain trailblazers. Everything we do is built with our users’ security and privacy first — with the ambition of making mass surveillance and censorship impractical.

The Job

We’re looking for a Mid-level or Senior Android Developer to join our Android app team at Mullvad. The team develops and maintains the app for the Android platform. Your primary focus will be working in Kotlin to maintain and bring new features to the Android app. The app is built with Kotlin and Rust, using modern Android development techniques. Our app and everything our team works on is open source and available on GitHub.

What you will do

    

Collaborate with our designers and other platform teams to bring new features from ideas to reality

    

Develop new features and maintain our Android codebase

    

Develop with a strong focus on security, covering both code behavior and the development process, including supply-chain security and code signing

Who you are

    

Strong knowledge in modern Android development (Kotlin, Compose, Gradle and other tools)

    

Good communication skills in English

    

Curious, and not afraid to question how and why things are done

Now it would be ideal if you have experience with

    

Networking

    

Testing and CI

    

Rust or have the will to learn

Why Mullvad?

We value quality over quantity and believe in good solutions rather than quick fixes. Our apps are open source, our teams are curious and collaborative, and we care deeply about removing bloat rather than adding it.

We are a group of different people: vegans and marathon runners, audiophiles, farmers, and coffee brewers. What brings us together is simple: we want to build technology that fights mass surveillance and censorship.

If you want to build products that make an impact, enjoy generous benefits, and work for a purpose you can stand behind, welcome to Mullvad.

Additional Information

Location: Gothenburg, Sweden Start: As soon as possible Job Hours: Full-time, on-site position

This is an ongoing recruitment process and we aim to fill the position as soon as possible. As part of our hiring process, we will conduct a background check.

title: Mechanical Lead - Data centres
description:
Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At COWI, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.

Be part of building COWI’s data centre environment.

As we scale our presence in this market, we are enhancing our multidisciplinary capabilities and working closely with clients to develop reliable, efficient and sustainable data centre solutions. In this role, you will engage closely with clients, colleagues and partners to develop and deliver data centre projects from early concept through design and implementation.

You will be part of a professional environment experiencing rapid growth and strong strategic focus within COWI, with opportunities to deepen your expertise, grow alongside the organisation, and play an active role in shaping our approach to data centre projects and customer collaboration.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

title: Growth Marketing Manager - Stockgolm
description:
As a Growth Marketing Manager at Twigeo, you'll work on growth strategy and run campaigns for some of the world's leading brands. We are trusted by globally recognized brands such as Duolingo, and MyFitnessPal, alongside high-growth apps and digital subscription businesses across diverse markets. Working with clients at this level makes Twigeo a place where people grow fast. You can see it in where our alumni are today, at companies like Snap, Meta, TikTok, and Tandem Health.

We're at a point where we want people who don't just run the playbook. If you've been the person on your team pushing new tools, testing AI workflows, and questioning how things have always been done, this is for you. You'll work on ambitious growth opportunities with a global team across New York, Los Angeles, Stockholm, and Varna, with the freedom (and expectation) to push things forward, and you'll never celebrate the wins alone.

The Growth Marketing role in action

You'll run growth and execution for our clients by:

    Managing performance campaigns with a strong focus on Search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) and paid social. Including budget pacing and allocation to invest spend effectively against client goals.
    Structuring, scaling, and optimizing Search campaigns across keywords, bidding strategies, and account structure to drive efficient growth.
    Building strong client relationships as a key day-to-day contact, supporting growth and measurement decisions, and growing into a trusted advisor on your accounts.
    Pushing how we work forward by testing new tools, AI workflows, and channel approaches on your accounts, and bringing what works to the wider team. You won't inherit our playbook; you'll help shape it.
    Collaborating across offices and departments, teaming up with creatives and analytics team to raise the bar on your accounts.

What makes you a great fit

Experience

    You have a couple of years of hands-on working with paid search, within performance or growth marketing.
    You've worked directly with clients before, whether in an agency or in-house, and you're comfortable owning conversations, not just listening in.
    You're getting confident with budget pacing and measurement fundamentals (attribution, tracking, reporting nuances) and want to deepen this further.

Communication

    You can explain CAC, ROAS, and other performance metrics to clients in a way they understand and act on.

Ownership & Growth

    You're highly motivated to learn and improve quickly, with a strong sense of ownership over your development.
    You're looking for a place where you shape how the work gets done, not just where you slot in. You bring ideas, you push for them, and you don't wait to be invited.

Builder mindset

    You can point to concrete examples, a new tool, AI workflow, or method you've tried, built, or introduced in the last 12 months, and what you learned or changed from it. You're not waiting for someone to hand you better tools.

What we offer

    30 paid vacation days to recharge
    A wellness contribution 5000 SEK/yearly to support your well-being
    A hybrid working model that balances collaboration and flexibility
    Growth opportunities in a global environment that encourages skill development and innovation

We know great marketers come from different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every single requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

title: Business Planning Analyst till LG Electronics
description:
Rekryteringsgruppen söker efter en Business Planning Analyst till vår kund, LG Electronics Nordic i Kista.  

Anställningen är på konsultbasis, med goda chanser till en fast anställning hos LG Electronics. Tjänsten är baserad på LG Electronics nordiska kontor i Stockholm.

Om rollen

Som Business Planning Analyst ansvarar du för att stödja organisationens strategiska planering och finansiella uppföljning. Du arbetar nära flera funktioner i verksamheten och bidrar med analyser och insikter som ligger till grund för viktiga affärsbeslut.

I rollen får du möjlighet att kombinera ekonomisk analys med marknadsbevakning och verksamhetsförståelse för att bidra till företagets fortsatta utveckling och lönsamhet.

ArbetsuppgifterAffärsplanering

    

Delta i framtagandet av affärsplaner i nära samarbete med olika delar av organisationen.

    

Säkerställa att affärsplaner stödjer verksamhetens strategiska mål.

    

Analysera marknadstrender och konkurrenssituation för att identifiera affärsmöjligheter.

Forecast och finansiell planering

    

Ta fram och underhålla rullande prognoser för verksamhetens framtida ekonomiska utveckling.

    

Följa upp nyckeltal och analysera utfall i relation till prognoser.

    

Justera prognoser utifrån verksamhetsresultat och förändrade marknadsförutsättningar.

P&L-analys och rapportering

    

Upprätta och analysera månads-, kvartals- och årsrapporter kopplade till resultat- och lönsamhetsutveckling.

    

Identifiera avvikelser och presentera rekommendationer för förbättringsåtgärder.

    

Bidra med datadrivna insikter för att stödja verksamhetens beslut.

Management Reporting

    

Utveckla och sammanställa rapporter och presentationer för ledningsgrupp och seniora beslutsfattare.

    

Säkerställa att rapportering är korrekt, tydlig och levereras i tid.

    

Presentera finansiella resultat, prognoser och strategiska initiativ på ett lättförståeligt sätt.

Market Sensing

    

Genomföra marknads- och omvärldsanalyser för att identifiera trender, risker och affärsmöjligheter.

    

Sammanställa och kommunicera insikter som stödjer långsiktig affärsutveckling.

Vi söker dig som har

    

Kandidatexamen inom företagsekonomi, finans, nationalekonomi eller annat relevant område.

    

Erfarenhet av affärsplanering, finansiell analys, controlling eller liknande arbetsuppgifter.

    

God förståelse för finansiell modellering, budgetering och prognosarbete.

    

Mycket god analytisk förmåga och ett strukturerat arbetssätt.

    

God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att presentera analys och resultat för olika målgrupper.

    

Avancerade kunskaper i Microsoft Excel.

    

Erfarenhet av finansiella system och analysverktyg är meriterande.

    

Flytande kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Personliga egenskaper

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är:

    

Affärsdriven och analytisk.

    

Självständig och ansvarstagande.

    

Strukturerad och noggrann.

    

Nyfiken med ett starkt intresse för marknad och affärsutveckling.

    

En lagspelare som trivs med många kontaktytor.

Vi erbjuder

    

En strategiskt viktig roll med stor påverkan på verksamhetens utveckling.

    

Möjlighet att arbeta nära beslutsfattare och ledning.

    

En internationell och dynamisk arbetsmiljö.

    

Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter för rätt person.

title: Privatrådgivare med fokus på bolån till SEB Telefonbank
description:
Arbetsbeskrivning  I rollen som Privatrådgivare med fokus bolån blir du en viktig del av teamet och arbetar med kundens hela bolåneresa – från ansökan och kreditbedömning till upplägg av lån samt löpande hantering av befintliga bolån. Du möter även kunder som kontaktar banken med frågor eller förändrade behov.

Som rådgivare säkerställer du att kundens hela privatekonomi tas om hand, antingen genom egen rådgivning eller genom att boka vidare möten med kollegor. Kundmöten sker på distans, huvudsakligen via telefon men även genom videomöten och skriftliga kanaler. Rollen ställer krav på god kreditkunskap och ett affärsmässigt arbetssätt.

Tjänsten är på heltid och arbetstiderna är förlagda mellan 07.45–18.15, med möjlighet att önska schema. Arbetet utförs på plats på SEB:s kontor i Solna (Arenastaden). Start för tjänsten är 3 november.  

Kvalifikationer och egenskaper  Vi söker dig som har ett stort engagemang för att skapa värde för kunder och bygga långsiktiga relationer. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och samarbetsvillig samt ser långsiktigt på din utveckling inom SEB.

För att bli aktuell i rollen ser vi att du:

    

Har erfarenhet av rådgivning och försäljning, gärna inom bank eller finans

    

Har förmåga att identifiera och förstå kundens behov

    

Är kommunikativ, lyhörd och affärsdriven

    

Har god kreditkunskap

    

Trivs i en roll där du driver affär och relation i nära dialog med kunder

Det är meriterande om du:

    

Innehar Swedsec rådgivarlicens, bolånelicens samt Intygande om Lämplighet för försäkringsdistribution

Om SEB  SEB är en ledande nordeuropeisk finansiell koncern med internationellt perspektiv. Vi tillhandahåller finansiella tjänster för företag, institutioner och privatkunder. Vi vill bidra till hållbar tillväxt och göra skillnad för våra kunder, aktieägare, medarbetare och samhället i stort. Genom vår expertis och höga servicenivå skapar vi möjligheter för våra kunder att fatta välgrundade beslut så att de kan förverkliga sina affärsambitioner och mål. Nu och för framtiden.

Välkommen till vår inkluderande kultur där våra gemensamma värderingar inspirerar och lyfter vårt team. Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter att alla medarbetare ska känna sig sedda, hörda och uppskattade.

Läs mer om hur det är att jobba på SEB här: www.sebgroup.com/career    Information kring rekryteringsprocessen  När du söker tjänsten ber vi dig svara på ett antal frågor och det är viktigt att du svarar på dessa utifrån bästa förmåga. Observera att alla ansökningar ska skickas via annonsen, då vi inte tar emot ansökningar per mejl. Vi tillämpar personlighets och logiktester i rekryteringen.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroller både av oss och av SEB. Du kommer även att bli ombedd att visa ett utdrag från belastningsregistret.

Frågor och kontakt  Vi väljer ut kandidater löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, vänta därför inte med att ansöka. I den här rekryteringen samarbetar SEB med Amendo.

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta någon av våra Talent Acquisition Managers Mathilda Carlbom på mathilda.carlbom@amendo.se. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Elevassistent till elev med diabetes
employer: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group ("friskola") with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is through both Swedish and English, with English the language of the corridors. IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at "Grundskolan" with 43 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993. IES Eskilstuna is one of the largest schools in Sweden with 1,185 students enrolled in grades F-9 and approx 125 staff members.

Elevassistent för elev med medicinska behov

Gör skillnad i vardagen för en elev med medicinska behov.

IES Eskilstuna söker en engagerad och trygg elevassistent som vill göra skillnad. I uppdraget som elevassistent är din främsta uppgift att arbeta med en enskild elev i åk 4-6 med omsorgsbehov. Rollen innebär att vara ett nära stöd för eleven under skoldagen och på fritidshemmet, med fokus på att säkerställa en trygg och fungerande vardag både i klassrummet och på raster.

Arbetsuppgifter

• Stödja eleven i skolarbetet och anpassa aktiviteter efter behov

• Vara ett tryggt och närvarande stöd under skoldagen och fritidsvistelsen

• Samarbeta nära lärare, vårdnadshavare och medicinsk personal för att säkerställa en trygg och stimulerande skolmiljö

• Agera stöd för övriga elever vid behov

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av arbete med barn i grundskola. Du har genomgått gymnasial omvårdnadsutbildning eller har motsvarande erfarenhet. Tidigare erfarenhet av ovan arbetsuppgifter är ett krav och du behöver kunskap och erfarenhet av barn med diabetes. Du är lyhörd, flexibel och har god samarbetsförmåga. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och samverka med elev, vårdnadshavare, arbetslag, skolans elevhälsoteam samt skolledning.

Du drivs av en vilja att se möjligheterna till förbättringar för såväl eleven och dina kollegor som för den egna verksamheten. Du har en förmåga att snabbt kunna anpassa dig till nya eller förändrade krav och förutsättningar. Att arbeta tillsammans med andra med en god sammanhållning och ett öppet arbetsklimat är något som du uppskattar och värdesätter.

Vi tror också att du:

• Är lugn, tålmodig och lyhörd

• Har förmåga att skapa trygghet och förutse situationer som kan påverka barnets välmående

• Gärna har utbildning som undersköterska eller annan relevant bakgrund

• Har kunskap och erfarenhet av barn med diabetes

Vi erbjuder:

• Ett meningsfullt arbete där du får vara en viktig del av ett barns utveckling och välmående

• En arbetsplats med stödjande kollegor

• Möjlighet att arbeta i en nära relation och göra en konkret skillnad varje dag

Tjänsten är på heltid, visstidsanställning, med start i så snart som möjligt.Rekryteringen sker löpande så vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

För att arbeta hos oss behöver du visa upp ett utdrag från belastningsregistret. Du kan beställa detta via denna länk:

https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Flexibel personlig assistent sökes – timanställning
description:
God Assistans erbjuder personlig assistans till kunder över hela Sverige. Vi är ett företag med stort hjärta, hög kompetens och ett genuint engagemang för det vi gör. Med lång erfarenhet inom personlig assistans strävar vi alltid efter att förenkla vardagen för våra kunder och skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö för våra medarbetare.
Vi tror på vikten av ett personligt bemötande, hög tillgänglighet och snabb service – och vi arbetar varje dag för att leva upp till detta.
För våra medarbetare erbjuder vi:

Kollektivavtal
Friskvårdsbidrag upp till 4000 kr/år
Kontinuerlig utbildning och kompetensutveckling

Inför en intervju ber vi dig att styrka din rätt att arbeta i Sverige genom att visa upp giltiga dokument, såsom svenskt pass/personbevis, uppehållskort (EU) eller uppehålls- och arbetstillstånd/LMA-kort (utanför EU). Enligt lagen om registerkontroll behöver du även uppvisa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister (Utdrag för arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning) om du ska arbeta med minderårig. Du kan enkelt beställa detta digitalt via polisens hemsida.
Vill du veta mer om oss? Besök gärna vår hemsida: http://www.godassistans.se

God Assistans bedriver personlig assistans för kunder över hela Sverige. Vi är ett företag med stort hjärta och hög kompetens som brinner för det vi gör och har lång erfarenhet inom assistans. Att värna om våra medarbetare och förenkla tillvaron för våra kunder är kärnan i vår verksamhet som kännetecknas av personligt bemötande, hög tillgänglighet och snabb service. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår hemsida: www.godassistans.se

Vill du arbeta extra i ett jobb där din insats verkligen betyder något? Vi söker nu en timanställd personlig assistent till en 30-årig man som bor i en egen stuga på sina föräldrars gård i Alingsås, omgiven av djur och natur.
Körkort och tillgång till bil är ett krav eftersom bostaden ligger utanför kollektivtrafiken. Bilkörning ingår i tjänsten.

Om uppdraget
Mannen lever med autism och epilepsi och behöver stöd i sin dagliga livsföring. På vardagarna är han på daglig verksamhet kl. 09:00–15:00, och efteråt deltar han gärna i aktiviteter eller matlagning – ett stort intresse.
Helgerna är ofta lugnare och spenderas gärna utomhus med promenader eller fika.

Vem söker vi?
Du är trygg, ansvarstagande och kan arbeta självständigt. Vi ser gärna att du är aktiv, strukturerad och trivs med att planera och genomföra aktiviteter.
Erfarenhet av autism och epilepsi är meriterande men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du kan skapa trygghet, har ett lugn bemötande, kan arbeta med tydliga rutiner och strukturerat.
Vi söker dig som är engagerad och vill bygga en god relation samtidigt som du bidrar till en stabil och meningsfull vardag.

Om tjänsten
Arbetstiderna varierar, men vardagspassen är oftast kl. 15:15–08:55 eller 15:15–21:15. Helgpassen kan vara kl. 09:00–15:00, 15:00–09:00 eller dygnspass.
Arbetet innebär främst kvälls- och nattpass med inslag av väntetid. På morgonen åker mannen färdtjänst till sin dagliga verksamhet.
Vi ser gärna att du är flexibel och kan arbeta extra vid behov.

title: Aftermarket Methods Engineer
description:
Transport and heavy equipment play an important role in modern society. This is an opportunity to use your technical expertise and practical experience to contribute to sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you enjoy combining hands-on technical understanding with engineering and want to work with next-generation technologies in a collaborative environment, this could be a great match.

What you will do:

As an Aftermarket Methods Engineer, you will play an important role in ensuring products can be serviced efficiently, safely, and sustainably throughout their lifecycle. You will develop and maintain service and repair methods for construction equipment products, with a primary focus on wheel loaders and powertrain components.

You responsibilities will include:

    Developing and improving service and repair methods and instructions for aftermarket operations.
    Supporting product development projects with serviceability expertise.
    Planning and executing service procedure development and time studies.
    Designing and validating special tools and workshop solutions.
    Collaborating with technical writers to ensure accurate and high-quality service documentation.
    Driving new ways of working by exploring and implementing digital technologies such as AI, VR, and other innovative solutions.
    Working closely with design engineers, product specialists, and other stakeholders across the organization.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how future products are maintained and serviced while contributing to an improved customer experience worldwide.

This team:

You will join a team of approximately 20 skilled and engaged colleagues based in Eskilstuna, working within aftermarket service technology.

The team's mission is to develop service methods, technical documentation, spare parts solutions, and serviceability improvements for wheel loaders, axles, transmissions, and engines. The team combines technical expertise with a strong customer focus to deliver solutions that support uptime, safety, and sustainability.

Who are you?

e believe you are a curious and solution-oriented person who enjoys combining technical expertise with practical applications. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are motivated by continuous improvement and innovation.

To be successful in this role, you likely have:

    Hands-on experience working with heavy vehicles, construction equipment, or similar products.
    A degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
    Strong technical understanding and an interest in developing efficient service solutions.
    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.
    A structured and analytical way of working.
    A valid driver's license (B).

It is considered a merit if you also have experience with:

    CAD and/or PDM systems.
    Hydraulics, electrical and electronic systems.
    Engines, transmissions, or driveline components.
    Service development, workshop operations, or technical documentation.

We know that no one checks every box. If you are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every qualification listed.

What’s in it for you?

You will be part of a global organization where innovation, collaboration, and sustainability are important parts of the work. The environment offers opportunities to develop both professionally and personally while working with technologies that shape the future of the industry.

You will join a diverse and supportive team where different perspectives are valued and where your ideas can make a real impact. Together with your colleagues, you will contribute to solutions that help customers succeed and support a more sustainable world.

Employment:

This is a consulting assignment, meaning you will initially be employed by Friday. The ambition of both Friday and the client is for the assignment to transition into a permanent position with the client after an initial consultancy period.

A background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

Additional information:

    Employment type: Full-time
    Start date: By agreement
    Location: Stockholm
    Point of contact: Moa Thegström

We review applications continuously. The recruitment process will resume after the summer, but we encourage you to submit your application today. Apply by clicking the link below. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

About Friday:

By being a partner to our clients and candidates, we strive to find the best match for both parties. We achieve this by really getting to know our clients' and candidates' needs. Of course, we ensure that requirements and skill sets match, but above all, we focus on finding harmony between values and company culture that both the candidate and the client consider optimal.

Our passion is helping people find the right position, workplace and context within IT and Technology. That's why we founded Friday – to help you find the job that gives you that Friday feeling, every day. We believe people reach their full potential when they look forward to going to work every morning.

title: Senior Software Engineer – ESG Data Repository
description:
Are you an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a passion for sustainability?

We are now recruiting a software engineer to join our journey and take long-term ownership of the ESG Data Repository — and we want you to help lead the way. The role involves working with a business-critical platform with high expectations on stability, scalability, and data quality. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of sustainable finance in Swedbank

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

    

Be part of a team with the purpose of ensuring stability, scalability, and data quality of ESG data in a business-critical platform.

    

Take end-to-end ownership of design, development, maintenance, and evolution of the ESG Data Repository.

    

Work hands-on with complex data models and enterprise-scale data flows.

    

Collaborate with senior stakeholders across technology and sustainability domains.

    

Contribute to long-term architectural decisions.

What is needed in this role:

•    A bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in Engineering and/or Computer Science.

•    Minimum 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with C# and SQL Server.

•    Strong, recent hands-on experience with SSIS and advanced T-SQL development.

•    Proven, hands-on experience designing and implementing Data Vault models.

•    Proven experience in building and maintaining REST APIs in enterprise environments.

•    Solid experience with Git-based version control in team-based development.

•    Proven responsibility for ownership, maintenance, and support of business-critical data platforms.

•    Hands-on experience working in SAFe-based agile organizations.

•    Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks) is meritorious.

•    Experience from IT development within financial services, or other highly regulated environments will be considered a strong advantage in the selection process.

•    Ability to independently solve complex technical challenges is essential.

•    Ability to contribute to technical decisions and improvements in data architecture will be important for success in this role.

•    Demonstrates a proactive approach to continuously learning new technologies and identifying opportunities to apply them to improve existing systems and processes.

•    Full professional proficiency in English is required. Ability to work in Swedish in a professional environment is required for effective collaboration.



With us, you can experience:

    

Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

    

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

    

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

    

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

    

Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.

"Join our team and...

be part of a dynamic and innovative environment where your ideas truly matter. You’ll have access to opportunities for professional growth and development, along a supportive team culture that values collaboration and balance." Alok Juneja, your future manager

We look forward to receiving your application by 06.09.2026.

Location: Stockholm, Sundbyberg

Recruiting manager: Alok Juneja

We may start the selection during the application period and welcome your application as soon as possible.

We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.

We have made our choice regarding recruitment media and therefore kindly decline contact with ad sellers or sellers of other recruitment services.

Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome.
