title: Strategisk Inköpschef
description:
Inom Alleima finns Indirekt inköp som består av fyra avdelningar - Strategiskt inköp, Operativt/taktiskt inköp, Förråd och godsmottag samt Processer och verktyg.

Hit söker vi nu en engagerad ledare för Strategiskt inköp som vill vara med på en spännande utvecklingsresa där du kommer att spela en nyckelroll. Låter det intressant? Då kan vi ha rätt roll för dig!

Din roll

Som Strategisk Inköpschef har du det övergripande ansvaret för att leda, driva och vidareutveckla den strategiska inköpsfunktionen. Du har personalansvar för teamet inom Strategiskt inköp och ansvarar för att skapa rätt förutsättningar för både medarbetarna och verksamheten att nå sina mål. Rollen kombinerar ledarskap, strategiskt inköp och affärsutveckling, med tydligt fokus på kostnadseffektivitet, leverantörsrisker, hållbarhet och långsiktigt värdeskapande.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter i rollen:

·      Leda, utveckla och följa upp teamet inom Strategiskt inköp med ansvar för medarbetarnas prestation, utveckling och engagemang

·       Sätta riktning, mål och prioriteringar för avdelningen och skapa förutsättningar för teamet att leverera på verksamhetens behov

·      Säkerställa efterlevnad av Alleimas inköpspolicy, styrande dokument samt efterlevnad av legala, miljömässiga och sociala krav

·      Driva förbättringar som gör inköpsarbetet mer effektivt och stärker samarbetet med leverantörer

·      Säkerställa avtal som är affärsmässigt och juridiskt hållbara samt skapar långsiktigt värde för verksamheten

·      Genom ett strategiskt, affärsnära och proaktivt arbetssätt bidrar du till ökad konkurrenskraft, kostnadseffektivitet och hållbarhet i hela organisationen

·      Använda och bidra till utveckling av digitala verktyg och data för analys, uppföljning och förbättrade beslutsunderlag

·      Nära samverkan med interna funktioner såsom produktion, facility management, R&D, kvalitet, juridik, hållbarhet, finans mfl

Som chef leder och utvecklar du ett team av strategiska inköpare som arbetar kategoristyrt inom indirekta inköpskategorier. Du skapar tydlighet kring mål, prioriteringar och förväntningar, följer upp prestation och utveckling och ger medarbetarna rätt förutsättningar att växa och ta ansvar. Du är trygg i att anpassa ditt ledarskap efter situation, individ och verksamhetens behov, samtidigt som du driver utveckling av arbetssätt, processer och inköpsmognad.

I rollen ingår även budget- och resultatansvar för avdelningen. Du rapporterar till Inköpschefen för Indirekt inköp och är en aktiv del i avdelningens ledningsgrupp.

Din Profil

Vi söker dig som har tidigare erfarenhet som chef med personalansvar och som är van att leda, utveckla och följa upp medarbetare. Du har också flera års erfarenhet av strategiskt inköp och/eller upphandling, exempelvis förhandling, avtalsarbete och utveckling av leverantörsrelationer. Vi ser gärna att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom inköp, logistik, teknik eller annat relevant område.

För att lyckas i rollen är du en strategisk och affärsmässig ledare med förmåga att omsätta affärsmål till tydliga prioriteringar för både teamet och inköpsarbetet. Du skapar struktur och riktning, tar ägarskap för att driva frågor till mål och använder analys och data som stöd i beslut, uppföljning och utveckling.

Du har även god vana av att arbeta i Microsoft 365 eller motsvarande digitala verktyg.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid dina personliga egenskaper där du är trygg, tydlig och har förmåga att anpassa ditt ledarskap efter situation, individ och verksamhetens behov. Du skapar riktning och tydliga förväntningar samtidigt som du ger medarbetarna förtroende och utrymme att ta ansvar och utvecklas. Du bygger förtroende, samarbetar väl med andra och har förmåga att påverka och driva förändring även utan formellt mandat.

Då rollen verkar i en global miljö är det ett krav att du behärskar både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Vad du kan förvänta dig av oss

På Alleima är vi övertygade om att mångfald och inkludering leder till en bättre arbetsplats för våra anställda, vårt företag och våra kunder.

Vi bryr oss: Vi är stolta över det vi gör. Vi bryr oss om våra kunder, våra medarbetare, miljön, de samhällen där vi verkar och den framtid vi delar.

Vi levererar: Vi levererar på våra åtaganden, med ett lösningsorienterat tankesätt gör vi det möjligt för våra kunder att vara deras allra bästa: Mer effektiva, lönsamma och hållbara.

Vi utvecklas: Vi utvecklas ständigt. Tillsammans tar vi ledningen för att främja material, ambitioner, industrier, oss själva – och samhällen till det bättre.

Övrig information

Vi ber vänligen rekryteringsföretag och andra försäljnings- eller konsultbolag att inte kontakta oss angående denna tjänst. I samband med anställning genomförs alkohol- och drogtest enligt våra rutiner för en säker arbetsmiljö. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen kommer vi även att genomföra en bakgrundskontroll.

För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta:

Helene Jansson, rekryterande chef, 070 314 25 28

För frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta:,

Alexandra Nylén, ansvarig rekryterare, 079 098 49 50

Fackliga kontaktpersoner:

Maria Sundqvist, Akademikerföreningen, 070 651 73 81

Kjell-Åke Klockervold, Ledarna, 070 314 24 43

Stefan Jonsson, Unionen, 070 396 03 00

Du är välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-13

På Alleima är vårt uppdrag mycket mer än att leverera högkvalitativa produkter, teknologi och processer – genom samarbete utvecklar vi de bästa lösningarna efter våra kunders behov som gör att vi uppnår våra affärsmässiga mål genom vårt dagliga arbete. Med nyfikna medarbetare och säkerheten som vår första prioritet, skapar vi en arbetsmiljö där Du kan utvecklas både som person och i ditt arbete.

Med en tydlig riktning för vår resa, där vi nyttjar vår position som teknologiledare, progressiv affärspartner och där vi är drivande vad gäller hållbarhet, syftar vi till att bli ett ännu starkare bolag inom vår industri.

Är Du redo att anta denna utmaning tillsammans med oss? Följ med på vår resa! www.alleima.com

title: Mekanikkonstruktör till JohSjö!
description:
Gillar du när steget från idé till färdig produkt är kort? Vill du också se när de saker du ritat kommer till liv? Då har vi på JohSjö Industri jobbet för dig!

Vilka är vi?

JohSjö Industri är det "stora lilla" företaget med runt 20 medarbetare. Det betyder att du blir en nyckelperson hos oss, inte bara ett namn i det stora hela. Besluten fattas snabbt och stämningen är familjär. Totalt i JohSjö-gruppen är vi ca 80 kollegor som samarbetar tätt inom både el och mekanik.

Vi är experter på rostfritt stål och har vår egen verkstad i direkt anslutning till kontoret. Det vi ritar, det bygger vi! Det kan handla om allt från avancerade rörsystem för  gasturbiner till processtankar för läkemedelsindustrin.

Så här kan din arbetsdag se ut:

Hos oss slipper du sitta isolerad i ett hörn. Du får vara med på hela resan, från första offert till slutleverans.

Dina primära uppdrag blir att:

    Konstruera rörsystem, svetsade konstruktioner och tryckkärl.
    Rita i SolidWorks (3D-modellering och ritningar).
    Arbeta med beredning mot produktionen
    Arbeta med inköp
    Göra tekniska beräkningar
    Ha en löpande dialog med gänget ute i verkstaden och externa kontrollanter (som Dekra och Kiwa).

Det bästa av allt? Du kan resa dig från skrivbordet, gå ut i verkstaden och se dina egna lösningar svetsas samman på riktigt.

Vem är du?

Vi bryr oss mer om vem du är än att du kan bocka av precis varje ruta på ett CV. Har du inte alla verktyg i lådan ännu? Ingen fara, vi hjälper dig att växa in i rollen!

Vi tror dock att du:

    Har bra koll på (eller ett stort intresse för) konstruktion och material.
    Trivs med att prata med både kunder och kollegor på både svenska och engelska.
    Är en lagspelare som tar egna initiativ och gillar att lösa problem när de dyker upp.

Guldstjärna om du har koll på något av detta:

    Trycksatta anordningar eller rörinstallationer.
    Svetskonstruktion eller beräkningar.
    Beredning och produktionsplanering.

Det där lilla extra:

Vi blir extra glada om du har ett praktiskt intresse även utanför jobbet. Gillar du att meka med bilen, renovera huset eller bygga egna projekt i garaget? Då kommer du att stortrivas hos oss!

Låter det som ditt nästa steg?

Vad kul! Då får du mer än gärna ansöka med ett CV så hör vi av oss för ett eventuellt nästa steg i processen.

Den här rekryteringsprocessen administreras av Job Solution Engineering, och kunden har begärt att alla frågor angående tjänsten hanteras av Job Solution Engineering. För eventuella frågor eller funderingar är du välkommen att höra av dig till mig. Du når oss på fredrik.hovstadius@jobsolution.se eller malek.yacoub@jobsolution.se

title: Consultant Acquisition Specialist
description:
Your New Role

We are looking for a Consultant Acquisition Specialist to join a dynamic organization and take responsibility for the end-to-end engagement lifecycle of external consultants within Staff Augmentation.

In this role, you will act as a key link between hiring managers, suppliers, Procurement and other stakeholders. You will ensure that consultant demand is clearly defined, sourced efficiently and handled in a structured, compliant and cost-conscious way.

You will work in an evolving environment where priorities can shift quickly, making strong judgement, communication and stakeholder management essential.

Key responsibilities

    

Manage the end-to-end consultant engagement process, ensuring accurate administration, traceability and compliance.

    

Review incoming consultant requests, clarify requirements and challenge unclear or incomplete demand.

    

Lead sourcing through the preferred supplier network, managing exceptions and escalations when required.

    

Select and brief suppliers, evaluate candidate submissions, build shortlists and provide structured feedback.

    

Support consultant selection and fee/rate alignment, using benchmarking and commercial insight to balance cost, quality and speed.

    

Manage consultant extensions, early terminations, offboarding and compliance-related escalations.

    

Collaborate closely with Procurement and internal stakeholders to strengthen processes, supplier performance and the preferred supplier model.

    

Contribute to KPI follow-up, reporting and continuous improvement of the consultant engagement process.

Company Presentation

Our client is a global retail company with strong values and a clear belief in the power of its people and teamwork. With stores around the world and modern offices in Stockholm, they offer a dynamic workplace where creativity, engagement, and personal growth are encouraged.

Good to Know

Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters. Start date: As agreed End date: 2027-04-30, with the possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

    

A relevant academic background in HR, Business, Procurement, Operations or a related field – or equivalent professional experience.

    

Experience in consultant acquisition, contingent workforce management, procurement-supported hiring, vendor management or a similar role involving suppliers, stakeholders and end-to-end process coordination.

    

Experience working with Vendor Management Systems (VMS) and preferably KPI reporting and data-driven follow-up.

    

The ability to navigate a complex organization and collaborate effectively across different functions.

What we Offer

    

Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

    

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)

    

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

    

Additional compensation during parental leave

    

Occupational health services

    

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

    

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We look forward to receiving your application

We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

title: SAP Business Receiver Lead
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will play a central role in an SAP implementation in a production environment where business readiness is critical to success. In this role, you act as the link between the project organization and the local business, making sure operational needs, business requirements, and ways of working are understood and reflected throughout the transformation.

You will work closely with managers, process owners, key users, and project stakeholders across functions. Your focus is to create alignment, support decisions, and help the organization prepare for new processes and systems in a structured and practical way. This is a strong opportunity for you who want to influence a major ERP transformation and make a clear impact on how digital processes support future operations.

Job Description

    You represent the production unit in the SAP implementation and make sure business perspectives are visible in all project phases.
    You build strong collaboration between the project organization and local stakeholders to secure alignment and commitment.
    You drive local readiness activities and help the business prepare for new processes, systems, and ways of working.
    You support business-related decision-making by clarifying needs, priorities, risks, and dependencies.
    You contribute to planning, testing, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization with a clear focus on business adoption.
    You identify challenges early and help define mitigation actions together with relevant stakeholders.
    You drive change management and user readiness initiatives to support successful implementation.
    You monitor progress related to business readiness and adoption and provide clear status updates to stakeholders.

Requirements

    Experience working within production, manufacturing, operations, business development, or project environments.
    Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders in industrial organizations.
    Experience leading or supporting business transformation initiatives.
    Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable activities.
    Strong stakeholder management skills.
    Excellent communication and coordination abilities.
    A structured and organized way of working.
    Strong problem-solving and decision-support capabilities.
    Ability to drive alignment across different functions and organizational levels.
    Experience supporting organizational change and process adoption.

Nice to have

    Experience from SAP implementations or other ERP transformation projects.
    Swedish language skills.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
What will you do?

As a Senior Android Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel Android app. We are in the middle of migrating from Java to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose while continuously shipping product features to a global user base.

You’ll work in a small, empowered team where your technical decisions matter. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our Android platform.

Areas of ownership:

    

Drive the migration from Java to a modern Kotlin + Compose stack

    

Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt

    

Build and modernize Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose

    

Contribute to architecture decisions (MVVM/MVI, Coroutines, platform improvements)

    

Collaborate closely with iOS, Web, Product, Design, and QA to ship the right solutions

    

Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed

    

Maintain and improve the overall health of the Android platform

Requirements:

    

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office

    

5+ years of experience building Android applications

    

Strong knowledge of Kotlin (and solid Java understanding)

    

Experience with modern Android architecture (Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, MVVM/MVI)

    

Proven ability to work independently and ship high-quality code

    

You care about the code you leave behind — you ship features without cutting corners

    

You prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over clever complexity

    

Experience migrating legacy Android codebases to modern stacks

    

Experience with mobile CI/CD, testing, or DevOps practices is a plus

    

It's a plus with experience with collaborating across platforms (iOS/Web)

Why Rebtel?

Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.

This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.

At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:

    

Pension Plan

    

Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

    

Dental Insurance

    

Occupational insurance

    

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

    

Discount on gym memberships

    

Bonus program

    

Extra parental pay

    

30 days annual vacation

    

Monday breakfasts

    

Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Business Controller
description:
Scania Credit Group (SCA), one of the captive Scania Financial Services entities, offers financing and insurance in the Middle East, Central Asia, and West Africa. SCA has become a leader in factoring solutions for non-captive dealers and body-builders, supporting Scania's goal to reduce CCC and offload its balance sheet. We have partnered with external credit insurers to mitigate commercial and political risks in certain transactions. SCA is expanding into new markets, particularly in the AMC region.

Based in Södertälje, the SCA Head Office and Market Support Centre provides governance, strategic development, credit risk management, contract administration, and IT support. With 50 employees, including 30 in Södertälje, we manage around 250 MEUR of assets across 10+ markets.

At SCA we value team spirit, diversity and respect. We believe that every employee should be able to be themselves at work. Our corporate culture is characterized by respect for the individual, continuous improvement and always putting the customer first.  

Role Summary

Are you passionate about financial analysis, business partnering, and continuous improvement? Do you enjoy turning data into insights and contributing to business performance? Join our team as a Business Controller, where you will contribute to both day-to-day controlling activities and the continued evolution of our finance function.

This is a broad and engaging role where you will combine financial analysis and business controlling with process improvement and digitalization initiatives. As our business continues to grow, you will play an important role in strengthening reporting capabilities, enhancing finance processes, and providing insights that support better decision-making across the organization.

You will contribute to monthly closing and reporting activities, business planning, forecasting, and management reporting, while helping to build efficient and scalable ways of working for the future. The role offers broad exposure across finance and the opportunity to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple international markets.

Job Responsibilities

Main responsibilities include:

    Contribute to the monthly closing process together with the Finance team, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting
    Perform financial performance analysis, business follow-up, and forecast reporting to support informed decision-making
    Prepare, monitor, and follow up on budgets, forecasts, and long-term business plans
    Support Group reporting and help ensure high-quality financial reporting and compliance
    Prepare financial presentations, reporting material, and analyses for the Board, Regional Management, and Leadership Teams
    Collaborate closely with the Financial Controller to meet evolving reporting, governance, and compliance requirements
    Partner with the Business Controller on strategic initiatives, ad hoc analyses, and cross-functional projects that support business growth and continuous improvement
    Drive digitalization and automation initiatives within Finance to enhance reporting capabilities and ways of working
    Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, strengthen data quality, and support scalability
    Act as a key support for the organization regarding reporting guidelines, financial systems, and finance best practices
    Contribute to the development of controlling processes and internal controls as the business continues to grow



Who You Are

You enjoy working with numbers and transforming data into meaningful business insights, but you are equally motivated by improving processes and finding smarter ways of working. You are analytical, structured, and proactive, with the ability to balance attention to detail with a broader business perspective.

To succeed in this role, you:

    Hold a degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with a few years' experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, Financial Reporting, or a similar role
    Have experience in financial reporting, planning, forecasting, and analysis
    Are analytical, curious, and solution-oriented
    Have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across functions
    Thrive in an international and dynamic business environment
    Are a team player who values knowledge sharing and collaboration
    Are fluent in English, both written and spoken
    Have excellent skills in Excel and PowerPoint
    Have experience with HFM, Power BI, or other finance systems (considered an advantage)



This Is Us

You'll be joining a Finance team of five colleagues based in Södertälje, where collaboration, trust, and knowledge sharing are at the heart of how we work. In this role, you will work closely with the Business Controller and Financial Controller, while partnering with colleagues across our international organization.

Our size allows for close collaboration, broad involvement across finance activities, and the opportunity to make a real impact. At the same time, our international presence provides exposure to colleagues and stakeholders across multiple markets and cultures.

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-28. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

title: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence subject (RAI) (www.ltu.se/robotics) at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a Postdoc contributing to our growing activities. The RAI team is conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on Aerial and Space robotics.



The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are robotics for mines, construction sites, aerial inspection of aging infrastructure, multi-robotic search and rescue, multi sensorial fusion and multirobot coordination, including multirobot perception, decentralization and mission execution.



The RAI team has a strong European participation in multiple R&D&I projects, while RAI was also participating in the DARPA SUB-T challenge with the CoSTAR Team lead by NASA/JPL (https://costar.jpl.nasa.gov/).



Subject description



Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.



Project description



You will be working in the field of robotics and artificial intelligence. More specifically, the position will involve dense research activities in the area of designing, experimenting and theoretical development with the following combined research areas linked with National, European and Worldwide R&D Projects.



Previous experience in one or preferably more topics from these areas is considered a merit:

    Multi-modal data processing for decision-making in natural environments
    Terrain classification and multi-layered environment mapping
    Digital twin generation for natural environments
    Semantic scene-understanding in natural environments for robust decision-making
    Learning-based traversability-aware path planning and safe trajectory generation
    Resilient mission design for applications such as soil sampling, surveillance etc.



Duties



The duties of a Postdoc primarily comprise research. You will perform research with substantial experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of PhD and MSc students, teaching and supporting in acquiring funds for future research projects from research funding agencies/councils, EU framework program or industry.



Qualifications



In order to be eligible for employment as post doctor you must have a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in Automatic control or electrical and electronics engineering or related subject. A doctoral degree awarded no more than three years before the application deadline provides a useful qualification. Candidates who have been awarded a doctoral degree at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example, different types of statutory leave of absence.



The research tasks require a solid mathematical background with proven advanced experimental capabilities and excellent programming skills (e.g. C++, ROS, Matlab, etc.). You should have a strong vision to evaluate and demonstrate the research findings in real life operating conditions, in an approach to close the gap between pure theory and experimental verifications. You will need to represent the group in different contexts, both in Sweden and abroad and hence have excellent skills in English.



Further information



The employment is limited to 2 years with possibility to be extended 1 year.



Placement: Luleå. Starting: Start according to agreement.



For further information please contact



Chaired Professor George Nikolakopoulos, (+46)920-49 1298, mailto:geonik@ltu.se



Union representatives:



SACO-S Diana Chroneer, (+46)920-49 2037 mailto:diana.chroneer@ltu.se



OFR-S Marika Vesterberg, (+46)920-49 1721 mailto:marika.vesterberg@ltu.se



In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.



Application



We prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a detailed CV with a full description of all the scientific merits and publications of the candidate, motivation letter, a research plan with a description of the research topics, list of successful grant applications, list of 2 persons that could provide recommendation for the candidate and copies of verified and translated diplomas from high school and universities. Your application must be written in Swedish or English. Mark your application with the reference number below.



Closing date for application: 9 September, 2026



Reference number: 4296-2026

title: Receptionist på deltid 8-13
description:
Trivs du i en roll där du får möta människor, skapa struktur och se till att kontoret fungerar som det ska? Som receptionist hos GlobalConnect i Uppsala blir du en viktig del av den dagliga kontorsupplevelsen för både medarbetare och besökare.

Det här är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid, med arbetstid kl. 08.00–13.00, fem dagar i veckan. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta deltid långsiktigt och uppskattar att kombinera service med administration och praktiskt kontorsstöd.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har

    Flytande svenska och professionell engelska i tal och skrift
    Möjlighet och ambition att arbeta deltid kl. 08.00–13.00, fem dagar i veckan, under överskådlig framtid
    Bekväm med att ge service både över telefon och i person.

Det är ett plus om du tidigare jobbat i service roller, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du har rätt motivation och är pålitlig och ansvarstagande.

Du blir en del av vårt Facility-team och utgår från kontoret i centrala Uppsala. Du rapporterar till Alexander som sitter i danmark och arbetar nära Tanya, som pur country lead för Sverige och Finland. Tanya finns på plats i Uppsala vissa dagar i veckan.

Du blir den enda receptionisten i Uppsala, samtidigt som du har en receptionist kollega i Stockholm att samarbeta med. Det innebär att du behöver känna dig bekväm med att själv planera din dag, se vad som behöver göras och ta ansvar för att arbetet går framåt.

Det här kommer du att arbeta med

    Ta emot och hjälpa besökare samt hantera inkommande telefonsamtal
    Hantera inkommande och utgående post och andra löpande receptionsuppgifter
    Hantera Facility-ärenden via Jira, mejl och Teams
    Ha kontakt med leverantörer, externa partners och fastighetsägare
    Stötta vid onboarding och offboarding samt se till att gemensamma ytor, mötesrum och kök fungerar väl
    Beställa kontorsmaterial och bidra i mindre Facility- och förbättringsprojekt
    Arbeta i facility relaterade förbättringsprojekt när tiden tillåter

Vem vi tror att du är

Du tycker om att hjälpa andra och känner dig bekväm både i personliga möten och i telefon. Du arbetar strukturerat, håller koll på vad som behöver göras och kan planera din dag även när ingen annan i teamet är på plats.

I den här rollen är det viktigt att du är pålitlig och tar initiativ. Under lugnare stunder ser du själv vad som kan förbättras eller göras klart, i stället för att vänta på nästa uppgift. Du uppskattar också en social vardag där du har kontakt med både kollegor, besökare och externa samarbetspartners.

Låter det här som du? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

    Inledande intervju med Talent Acquisition
    Första intervju Tanya
    Slutintervju med Alexander
    Referenstagning

Vänligen notera att personlighets- och kognitiva tester kommer att vara en del av processen.

Praktisk information

    Placering: GlobalConnects kontor i centrala Uppsala
    Arbetstid: kl. 08.00–13.00, måndag till fredag
    Rollen är kontorsbaserad och kräver närvaro på plats varje arbetsdag
    Vid enstaka tillfällen behöver du kunna arbeta från Stockholm, exempelvis vid semesterbemanning eller gemensamma teamaktiviteter

Det här är en roll för dig som vill bli en viktig del av vardagen på kontoret och kombinera service, eget ansvar och struktur i ett långsiktigt deltidsarbete.

Du behöver inte skicka något personligt brev – skicka bara ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil.

Välkommen med din ansökan till GlobalConnect.

GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

title: Staff Engineer – Product & Tech to Lendo
description:
Shape the technical direction at Lendo – and help build the future of our Product & Tech organization.

Do you want to influence both technology and how engineering works across an entire organization? As Staff Engineer at Lendo, you will play a key role in shaping our technical direction, architecture and engineering practices across Product & Tech. Lendo is a successful fintech company with a strong financial position, ambitious plans and a modern Product & Tech organization. We are continuously developing our offering and exploring new products, technologies and ways of creating value for our customers. You will work from our modern office in central Stockholm, where collaboration, great coffee, snacks and a social environment are part of everyday life.

Vi erbjuder dig

    You get the opportunity to influence both technology and the wider Product & Tech organization.
    You will work directly with senior stakeholders and be part of the Product & Tech leadership team.
    Lendo combines a modern technical environment with an ambitious product and technology roadmap.
    Your impact will go beyond writing code – you will help shape architecture, technical standards, engineering capabilities and ways of working.
    You will join Lendo at an exciting time, with new products and exciting product initiatives ahead.

Det här gör du hos oss

As Staff Engineer, you will be part of the Product & Tech leadership team, working closely with Engineering Managers, the Head of Technology and other key stakeholders to shape the technical direction across Product & Tech. You will act as a technical compass across our engineering organization, helping teams make sound technical decisions while staying close enough to the engineering work to understand and solve complex challenges.

You will:

    Own and evolve Lendo´s technical strategy, architecture and engineering standards.
    Set technical direction across multiple agile teams and create alignment around architecture and ways of working.
    Facilitate our Tech Lead forum and drive cross-team technical initiatives.
    Work with Product from an early stage to turn business needs into scalable technical solutions.
    Stay hands-on when needed through coding, prototyping and technical problem-solving.
    Mentor engineers and act as a technical sounding board across backend and frontend.
    Participate in technical skills assessments of engineers, helping ensure a consistent and high technical standard across the organization.
    Support teams in areas such as resilience, security, operational risk and major technical incidents.
    Work closely with our Data/ML team and explore how AI and modern technologies can create business value.

Ditt team och arbetsplats

The environment is modern, product-driven and forward-looking, with several new products and initiatives on the roadmap. This means you get the opportunity to influence areas that are still evolving, rather than simply stepping into an already established structure.

The role sits close to the wider Product & Tech leadership, rather than being limited to one individual development team. You will work closely with senior stakeholders and have the opportunity to influence decisions across the broader technology organization.

Mer om dig

We are looking for a senior engineer with a strong architectural mindset who enjoys solving complex problems and influencing others through technical expertise rather than formal authority.

You have:

    Extensive experience in software engineering, architecture or a similar senior technical role.
    Strong knowledge of modern software architecture and experience working across multiple teams.
    Experience with cloud environments, ideally GCP, and technologies such as Kubernetes and Terraform.
    Experience with or a strong understanding of Golang, TypeScript and/or React.
    The ability to move comfortably between strategic technical discussions and hands-on engineering.
    Strong communication skills and the ability to turn complex technical topics into clear decisions and actions.
    A pragmatic approach to balancing technical quality, business value and speed.
    A genuine interest in AI and modern technology.

Experience from a regulated or high-trust environment and/or working closely with Data/ML teams is a plus.

Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative and pragmatic. You take ownership, challenge existing solutions when needed and enjoy helping both people and technology move forward.

Så här får vi kontakt

title: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence subject (RAI) (http://www.ltu.se/robotics) at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a Postdoc contributing to our growing activities. The RAI team are conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on Aerial and Space robotics.



The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are robotics for mines, construction sites, aerial inspection of aging infrastructure, multi-robotic search and rescue, multi sensorial fusion and multirobot coordination, including multirobot perception, decentralization and mission execution.



The RAI team has a strong European participation in multiple R&D&I projects, while RAI was also participating in the DARPA SUB-T challenge with the CoSTAR Team lead by NASA/JPL (https://costar.jpl.nasa.gov/).



Subject description



Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.



Project description



You will be working in the field of aerial robotics and the activities will be linked with National, European and Worldwide R&D Projects.



Characteristic research topics will focus on, but not be limited to, the following areas, where a proof of previous work with experimentally verified results is necessary:

    Navigation through unknown environments
    Rapid dynamics-based planning
    Semantic-based Exploration
    Source localization
    Perception in sensor-degraded environments:
    Localization in smoke and dust filled environments
    Scene awareness
    Biometric/triage evaluations, etc.
    Mission-specific modules such as autonomous firefighting, sampling, rescue operations, or large-scale mission planning.



Duties



The duties of a Postdoc primarily comprise research. You will perform research with substantial experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of PhD and MSc students, teaching and supporting in acquiring funds for future research projects from research funding agencies/councils, EU framework program or industry.



Qualifications



In order to be eligible for employment as post doctor you must have a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in Automatic control or related subject. A doctoral degree awarded no more than three years before the application deadline provides a useful qualification. Candidates who have been awarded a doctoral degree at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example, different types of statutory leave of absence.



The research tasks require a solid mathematical background with proven advanced experimental capabilities and excellent programming skills (e.g. C++, ROS, Matlab, etc.). You should have a strong vision to evaluate and demonstrate the research findings in real life operating conditions, in an approach to close the gap between pure theory and experimental verifications. You will need to represent the group in different contexts, both in Sweden and abroad and hence have excellent skills in English.



Further information



The employment is limited to 2 years with possibility to be extended 1 year.

Placement: Luleå. Starting: Start according to agreement.



For further information please contact

Chaired Professor George Nikolakopoulos, (+46)920-49 1298, mailto:geonik@ltu.se

In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.



Application



We prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a detailed CV with a full description of all the scientific merits and publications of the candidate, motivation letter, a research plan with a description of the research topics, list of successful grant applications, list of 2 persons that could provide recommendation for the candidate and copies of verified and translated diplomas from high school and universities. Your application must be written in Swedish or English. Mark your application with the reference number below.

Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

What you know

title: Workforce Management Expert
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.

You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.

You will:

    Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
    Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
    Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
    Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
    Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
    Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
    Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
    Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
    Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
    Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
    Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
    Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.

We are looking for people with:

    Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
    Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
    Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
    Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
    Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
    Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
    Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
    Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

An example of our benefits:

    25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
    H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future Senior Digital Marketing Manager Sweden!

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and have been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

We are approximately 450 employees based in Stockholm, working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Sweden.

Role summary:

In this role you will lead the strategy, activation, and optimization of our digital marketing ecosystem across CRM, Paid Media, Retail Media, and Social Media.

In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive consumer acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty through data-driven marketing programs and omnichannel experiences. You will be responsible for shaping how our brands connect with consumers across the full customer journey, maximizing marketing effectiveness while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Working cross-functionally with Brand, Commercial, Consumer Experience, E-commerce, and Digital teams, you will transform insights into action, champion innovation, and continuously evolve our marketing capabilities through automation, personalization, analytics, and emerging technologies.

If you're passionate about growing brands, accelerating consumer engagement, and delivering market-leading results through digital marketing excellence, this is your opportunity to drive meaningful business impact while shaping the future of our brands in Sweden!



Main accountabilities:

    Shape and execute the digital marketing strategy across CRM, Paid Media, Retail Media, and Social Media.
    Drive consumer acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty through best-in-class digital experiences.
    Lead marketing investments and performance optimization to maximize business impact and return on investment.
    Develop personalized consumer journeys using data, automation, and CRM innovation.
    Build engaging social media and content strategies that strengthen brand relevance and advocacy.
    Leverage insights, experimentation, and analytics to fuel continuous growth.
    Lead cross-functional collaboration and champion digital marketing excellence across the organization.
    Coach and develop a high-performing team while driving innovation and continuous improvement.                                                                                                                                                                                                    

Qualifications & Skills:

    Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
    7+ years of experience in digital marketing, CRM, performance marketing, media management, or related fields.
    Proven track record of leading integrated CRM, Paid Media and Social Media strategies.
    Strong understanding of consumer lifecycle marketing, audience segmentation, personalization, and automation.
    Experience with digital analytics, attribution, performance measurement, and marketing investment optimization.
    Knowledge of marketing technologies, AI-enabled marketing solutions, and digital innovation practices.
    Strong leadership and people development capabilities with experience coaching and building high-performing teams.
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    Proficient in English, Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.                                                                                    



What we offer:

Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join us at Swedish Match and you too can:

• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.

• Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.

• Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.

• Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.

• Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

title: Mechanical Lead - Data centres
description:
Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At COWI, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.

We are therefore looking for a Mechanical Lead to join us on this journey, becoming an integral part of our growing organisation and helping evolve our data centre environment through your expertise in complex projects.

Be part of building COWI’s data centre environment.

Data centres are a strategic growth area at COWI. As we scale our presence in this market, we are enhancing our multidisciplinary capabilities and working closely with clients to develop reliable, efficient and sustainable data centre solutions. In this role, you will engage closely with clients, colleagues and partners to develop and deliver data centre projects from early concept through design and implementation.

As Mechanical Lead, you will bring your expertise in mechanical systems into multidisciplinary teams, helping translate customer needs into robust and future-ready solutions. You will be part of a professional environment experiencing rapid growth and strong strategic focus within COWI, with opportunities to deepen your expertise, grow alongside the organisation, and play an active role in shaping our approach to data centre projects and customer collaboration.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

    Contribute to the design and delivery of data centre projects, ensuring high technical quality within your discipline.
    Engage in dialogue with customers to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
    Lead and contribute to data centre projects, ensuring coordination across multidisciplinary teams.
    Support project development from early concept stages through design, tender and construction.
    Collaborate with colleagues across engineering, architecture, sustainability and environmental advisory.

Examples of discipline-specific responsibilities may include:

    Lead mechanical design and advisory for data centre facilities.
    Act as mechanical lead within projects, ensuring technical quality and coordination.
    Contribute to detailed technical dialogue with clients and project stakeholders.
    Support project development from concept to detailed design.
    Contribute to innovative and sustainable data centre solutions.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

    A relevant educational background in engineering.
    Experience working with design of data centres, engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
    Experience from data centre projects or other large-scale mission critical projects.
    Professional proficiency in English.

Additional role-specific qualifications may include:

    Experience with mechanical systems for data centres.
    Experience working with large-scale infrastructure or industrial facilities.
    Experience leading technical teams or complex engineering projects.

Work location

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia. This includes offices in:

Norway – Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger, Oslo and Fredrikstad

Sweden – Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö

Denmark – Copenhagen, Kongens Lyngby, Vejle, Aarhus, Odense and Aalborg

We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.

Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com. Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com and www.arkitema.com where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

•    Proven, hands-on experience designing and implementing Data Vault models.

Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.

title: Installation Lead
description:
Bring the Future of Wind Propulsion Onboard

About Us

Wind helped us discover our planet, and now it can help us preserve it. Our vision is to provide wings for a shipping revolution, and we have two strong mother companies to back us up: Alfa Laval and Wallenius.

Would you like to contribute to this change, then join our fast-growing, highly competent and passionate team. AlfaWall Oceanbird AB is a 50/50 joint venture, owned by Alfa Laval and Wallenius but operated as an independent company. We are developing wing sail technology for the global shipping market and are now looking for an Installation Lead to join our team. Help us bring wind propulsion from shore to ship!

The role

As Oceanbird moves from a prototype stage into commercial customer delivery, successful installation is becoming one of our most important capabilities.

As Installation Lead, you will turn plans and technical solutions into safe, efficient and wellcoordinated installations at shipyards and onboard vessels. You will also be responsible for our demonstrator wing in Landskrona, coordinating its operation, maintenance and test readiness so that it provides the data needed for our continued development.

You will be part of the Project Management Office and work closely with our project managers. During installations, you will lead a cross-functional team of approximately 3–8 people, including electricians, service engineers, technical specialists and external contractors.

The Project Manager retains overall responsibility for the customer project, while you lead the dayto-day installation activities and safe execution at the shipyard, in harbor or at sea.

Your main responsibilities:

• Plan, prepare and lead installation and commissioning activities at shipyards/harbour and onboard vessels.

• Translate project and engineering requirements into practical installation plans, work sequences, resource needs and schedules.

• Coordinate the on-site installation team and act as Oceanbird’s operational interface with shipyards, vessel crews, customers and subcontractors.

• Lead the safe execution of installation work, ensuring that risk assessments, work permits, toolbox talks and agreed safety procedures are in place and followed.

• Monitor progress, quality and safety, resolve practical issues and escalate risks or decisions when required.

• Develop and maintain installation procedures, method statements, SOPs, checklists and installation manuals.

• Capture lessons learned and use them to improve future installations, documentation and ways of working.

• Coordinate the operation, maintenance, inspection and test readiness of the demonstrator wing and its supporting equipment in Landskrona.

• Plan activities together with the Landskrona team and work closely with our teams in Flemingsberg to incorporate experience from installations and testing into our continued development.

Who are you?

You are a practical and confident installation leader who can bring people from different disciplines together, create structure and maintain focus on safety and delivery—even when conditions change.

You are likely to have:

• Experience leading installations, commissioning, service or major maintenance involving complex mechanical or electromechanical equipment.

Classified by Alfa Laval as: Business

• Experience from commercial vessels and shipyards, ideally involving bulk carriers, tankers or similar vessel types.

• Experience from newbuild projects and working closely with shipyards in Asia is highly valuable.

• A relevant engineering qualification within mechanical, marine, electrical or a related technical field. This could be a vocational, college or bachelor-level qualification, or equivalent experience.

• A strong understanding of safe working practices in shipyard, industrial or onboard environments.

• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, contractors and external stakeholders.

• The ability to produce clear and practical technical documentation, including SOPs and installation manuals.

• Professional proficiency in English and the willingness to travel internationally and work onboard vessels.

You are safety-conscious, structured and calm under pressure. You communicate clearly across technical disciplines and cultures and are comfortable moving between planning, documentation and hands-on execution.

Location and travel

We are open to discussing the location for the right candidate, although proximity to either Flemingsberg or Landskrona is preferred.

Regular international travel and periods of work at shipyards and onboard vessels are an integral part of the role.

What we offer

At Oceanbird, you will help turn a bold vision into working technology at sea. You will see the direct result of your work as our wing sail technology moves from development and testing to installation onboard commercial vessels—and ultimately into operation at sea.

This is an opportunity to shape not only how our first commercial installations are delivered, but how Oceanbird will install wing sails around the world in the future. Working alongside highly skilled and passionate colleagues, you will influence our installation methods, safety standards and ways of working—and contribute directly to making wind a powerful part of cleaner shipping.

Join us in redefining the future of clean shipping.

Apply today and be part of a journey that truly makes a difference!

We review applications continually so please send in your application as soon as possible.

We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

title: Senior Business Controller – Software & Tech
description:
Would you like to combine business controlling, financial analysis, and business-oriented advisory in an environment where software and advanced technology are at the core? 📊💻

We are looking for a Senior Business Controller for a long-term consulting assignment in Gothenburg. In this role, you will work closely with senior decision-makers, transforming financial data into insights, challenging assumptions, and contributing to well-informed business decisions.

You will work in a technology-intensive organization developing software for modern vehicles, including digital services, infotainment, and advanced driver assistance systems. 🚗

About the Role

As a Senior Business Controller, you will have broad responsibilities combining operational controlling, project and program follow-up, and business partnering. You will work closely with senior management and act as a proactive financial partner in both strategic and operational matters.

An important part of the role is creating transparency around costs, budgets, and forecasts. You will analyze financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that relevant decision-making data and insights are available.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    

Acting as a financial partner to senior management, providing clear analyses and recommendations.

    

Driving monthly financial follow-up, including variance analyses and performance reviews.

    

Working with OPEX, cost control, and monitoring financial KPIs.

    

Managing budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial planning for various programs and projects.

    

Monitoring project costs, burn rates, and forecast accuracy, and highlighting deviations.

    

Collaborating cross-functionally with engineering, procurement, program management, and other functions.

    

Reviewing purchase requests and supplier invoices to ensure compliance with budgets, contracts, and internal guidelines.

    

Driving recurring budgeting and forecasting processes.

    

Preparing financial analyses and presentations for senior management.

    

Proactively identifying financial risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 📈

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in controlling who thrives in a business-oriented role. You are analytical and structured, but above all, you have the ability to understand the business behind the numbers and translate your analysis into concrete recommendations.

You are comfortable working independently, challenging existing assumptions, and communicating financial matters to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

Ideally, you have:

    

A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or equivalent.

    

At least 3–5 years of experience in business controlling, financial controlling, business partnering, program controlling, or a similar role.

    

Solid experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling.

    

Strong analytical skills and experience working with large volumes of financial data.

    

Experience working cross-functionally and closely with senior stakeholders.

    

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

    

Excellent spoken and written English.

Experience from automotive, technology, engineering, or another development-intensive environment is considered an advantage. Previous experience in project controlling, program controlling, or automotive development programs is also a plus.

Additional Merits

Experience with the following is considered an advantage:

    

Power Query / Excel Query and macros

    

Power BI

    

SAP S/4HANA

About the Assignment

📍 Location: Gothenburg, on-site 📅 Start date: September 1, 2026 ⏳ Assignment period: Until August 31, 2027 🕒 Scope: Full-time, 40 hours per week

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to take on a central financial role close to the business while working in an environment where finance meets software development and advanced technology.

title: Finance Manager to Öhlins Group
description:
Do you want to take on a key role in a world-leading technology company with one of Sweden’s strongest brands in motorsport and premium vehicles? Do you thrive at the intersection of operational accounting, group reporting, and leadership? Then the role as Finance Manager at Öhlins could be the next step in your career.

Öhlins is in an exciting phase where the focus on business performance, cash flow, and financial governance is greater than ever. We are now looking for a Finance Manager who wants to help develop the finance function in an international environment.

Your Challenge

As Finance Manager, you will have overall responsibility for accounting and financial reporting across the Group. This is a central role within the organization, involving close collaboration with the CFO, management team, and colleagues in our international subsidiaries. You will be responsible for ensuring high quality in accounting, financial closings, and reporting while leading a high-performing finance team. The role combines hands-on operational work with leadership responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence processes, ways of working, and the continued development of the finance function.

The position is based at the headquarters in Upplands Väsby and reports directly to the CFO.

Your Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for:

    Responsible for all accounting and reporting, including monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and external reports

    Ensure timely and accurate preparation of financial statements, reports and forecasts in accordance with GAAP and regulatory requirements

    Serve as the primary internal expert on Swedish GAAP (K3), statutory reporting and local regulatory requirements.

    Develop, structure and maintain accounting department procedures and internal controls

    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support budgeting, forecasting and financial planning

    Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making and strategic planning

    Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors and regulators

    Stay up to date on accounting standards, regulations and industry trends to ensure compliance and best practices

    Lead and develop the accounting team and foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth

    Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to streamline workflows and increase efficiency.

Qualifications

We believe you have:

    A university degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field

    Approximately 7-10 years of experience in accounting and finance

    Experience managing or leading an accounting function

    Extensive knowledge of K3 accounting standards, annual reporting, and Swedish regulatory frameworks

    Demonstrated experience preparing annual reports for Swedish legal entities

    Experience with group accounting and consolidation

    Strong systems proficiency and an interest in efficient processes

    Experience from an international organization is considered an advantage

    Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken as communication and documentation take place in both languages

If you have a background in auditing, preferably with a Big Four firm, we consider that particularly interesting.

Personal Attributes

To succeed in this role, you are a confident and down-to-earth professional who enjoys collaboration and building long-term relationships. You are a natural team player who builds trust across the organization and works effectively both with your team and with other functions within the business. You are structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused, with strong analytical skills and sound business acumen. You are confident in your accounting expertise, able to balance attention to detail with a holistic perspective, and motivated by developing both people and processes to create sustainable improvements and results.

About Öhlins Group

Passion, Performance, Perfection — this is the Öhlins way. Our passion for innovation and state-of-the-art technology is the driving force in our search for the next generation of advanced suspension technology. Öhlins has been a cornerstone of the motorsport, motorcycle, and automotive industries for over 45 years. Since day one, our focus has been on delivering high-quality products, service, and support—from the MotoGP circuit to national and local racing events—in over 50 distributing countries. We supply the aftermarket, OEM partners, and teams with high-end suspension technology, and strive to exceed the expectations of our customers around the world.

Application

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you match the profile described above, we encourage you to apply today using the application button.In this recruitment process, Öhlins Group is partnering with Gazella. If you have any questions, please contact Bilge Kaya (bilge.kaya@gazella.se) at Gazella, who is the recruiter responsible for this position.
